decisionRule: anchor PASS iff both Wilson lower bounds clear (>=5 buyers, >=20 no-trade); FAIL iff either upper bound misses; overall PROJECTED_PASS iff interval-PASS anchors >= 60%; PROJECTED_FAIL iff PASS+UNCERTAIN < 60%; else UNCERTAIN
membership: PIT_TOP120_CONDITIONED: latest signal-history ledger/universe/kr snapshot on or before the anchor, rank <= 120 (common and preferred share lines ranked together; the issuer is matched on its DART common stock code)
preregisteredGate: at least 60% of anchors with >= 5 NET_BUYER and >= 20 NO_OPEN_MARKET_TRADE names, from filings alone
projectionStatement: PROJECTION from a deterministic 24-issuer sample (kr_insider_probe.issuer_sample(24), first 24 of 254 DART-resolved ever-Top-120 issuers by sha256(corp_code)); per-anchor counts are the sampled members only and the Top-120 figures are 120 x sample share with a Wilson 95% interval that treats sampled members as a random draw. The same issuers recur across anchors, so anchor verdicts are NOT independent.

lateRowProfile.reading: descriptive: a 1-4 calendar-day gap on an open-market row is the shape a settlement-date (T+2) 변동일 would leave on a promptly filed report; this is an observation about the filings, not a verified explanation, and it does not change the owner rule

quarantineRule: owner rule added 2026-11-04 before any outcome: a filing with ANY detail row dated after its DART receipt date is QUARANTINED (kr_insider.build_event -> Quarantine) and never contributes to a state; not part of the frozen registration's text, recorded here as a pre-outcome addition

quarantineRuleBound.purpose: bound, not a substitute: the same gate with the owner quarantine rule switched OFF (every parsed original contributes). The primary verdict is the rule-ON one; this only shows how much of it the rule decides. No alternative rule is proposed or tuned here.

source.parserNote: parser kr_insider v2 left UNCHANGED (frozen with the registration): the observed PARSE_ERROR shape is a share-count cell whose digits are split by a line break (e.g. '-\n2000', '-600\n00'); fixing it would be a parser v3 = a new registration decision for the owner, and it is far below the 5% SOURCE_BLOCKED limit

summary.pooledNote: pooled over all anchor x issuer cells; cells of the same issuer on consecutive anchors are strongly dependent, so this interval is too narrow and is NOT the gate

window: 63 KRX sessions ending on the anchor; filing usable from the first session strictly after receipt
